subject: [hw] K02 rev 7: typo correction in my DONE post (q10jx line)
body: In my DONE rev 7 the last not-done bullet has a garbled fragment. It should read: "q10jx stays on 7ded4040: functionally correct (273 MHz for vcodecd, 624 MHz for JPEG), it only lacks the venc_sel log line that e601a947 adds; no rebuild needed for q10jx." Nothing else in that post changes.
